title: Merchant transaction settled
description: This event occurs when a merchant's transactions are settled.

creditor_id.title: The creditor identifier
creditor_id.description: This field identifies the creditor related to merchant thats requires the settlement transaction.

merchant_id.title: The merchant identifier
merchant_id.description: This field identifies the merchant related to settlement transaction.

marketplace_id.title: The marketplace identifier
marketplace_id.description: This field identifies the marketplace related to settlement transaction.

merchant_transaction_id.title: The merchant transaction identifier
merchant_transaction_id.description: This field identifies the merchant settlement transaction.

org_operation_id.title: The operation identifier relate to organization
org_operation_id.description: This field identifies the operation related to settlement transaction.

scheduled_payment_date.title: The scheduled payment date of settlement transaction
scheduled_payment_date.description: This field identifies the scheduled payment date related to settlement transaction.

transaction_amount.title: The transaction amount of settlement transaction
transaction_amount.description: This field identifies the transaction amount related to settlement transaction.

transaction_status.title: The transaction status of settlement transaction
transaction_status.description: This field identifies the status of settlement transaction.

advanced_amount.title: The advanced amount of settlement transaction
advanced_amount.description: This field identifies the transaction advanced amount related to settlement transaction.

advancement_request_id.title: The advancement request identifier if the transaction was created for an advancement
advancement_request_id.description: This field identifies the advancement request that generated this transaction.

authorization_id.title: The authorization identifier
authorization_id.description: This field identifies the authorization identifier related to settlement transaction.

event_date.title: The settlement event date
event_date.description: This field identifies the settlement event date (in UTC RFC 3339 format).

mdr_amount.title: The mdr amount of settlement transaction
mdr_amount.description: This field identifies the transaction mdr amount related to settlement transaction.

mdr_tax.title: Amount of Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) tax

origin_transaction_id.title: The identifier of original transaction related to settlement transaction
origin_transaction_id.description: This field identifies the original transaction identifier related to settlement transaction.

processing_code.title: The processing code relate to transaction
processing_code.description: This field identifies the processing code related to transaction.

settlement_amount.title: The settlement amount of settlement transaction
settlement_amount.description: This field identifies the transaction settlement amount related to settlement transaction.

settlement_date.title: The settlement date of settlement transaction
settlement_date.description: This field identifies the settlement date related to settlement transaction.

settlement_id.title: The merchant settlement identifier
settlement_id.description: This field identifies the settlement that changed the transaction status.

payment_info.title: The payment info.
payment_info.description: Additional information related to the payment.

program_id.title: The program identifier
program_id.description: This field identifies the program related to the merchant

discount_amount.title: Total discount amount
discount_amount.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction
